fleetHealth.title: Fleet Health Score
fleetHealth.infoBody: Four equally-weighted factors, each worth up to 25 points:
fleetHealth.infoTruck: Truck: compliance items (DOT inspection, IRP, insurance, CDL, medical card, etc.) — red if any is overdue, amber if due soon.
fleetHealth.infoMaintenance: Maintenance: Truck Health interval statuses (oil, tires, and the rest) — red if any is overdue, amber if due soon.
fleetHealth.infoTaxes: Taxes: your Business Balance compared to the upcoming quarterly payment — red below 50% reserved, amber below 100%.
fleetHealth.infoCashFlow: Cash Flow: this week's net profit vs. last week — red if down, amber if flat.

categoryLearning.title: Category Learning
categoryLearning.subtitle: Rules learned from your own manual category corrections.
categoryLearning.notTrainedNote: This only adjusts the hints sent along with your own future imports — the AI model itself is never trained or fine-tuned on your data.

categoryLearning.clearAllConfirmBody: This removes all {{count}} learned rule(s). Future imports will rely on the built-in category guesser again until you correct a category and teach a new rule.

accountantPackage.title: Accountant Package
accountantPackage.subtitle: Out-of-pocket expenses, ready to hand to your CPA — pick a year, month, and scope below.
accountantPackage.noLoansCards: No loans or credit cards on file.
accountantPackage.incomeSubtitle: Settlement income lines besides linehaul/fuel surcharge — reimbursements are already netted into the expense categories above, not counted here.
accountantPackage.shareNotAvailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
accountantPackage.scopeOutOfPocketNote: For your accountant — the carrier's own accountant already has the settlement-withheld side.
accountantPackage.reconcilingCaption: This total reconciles with the category breakdown below.
accountantPackage.perDiemNote: Per diem is claimed separately from these expenses; meal receipts are excluded (covered by per diem).
accountantPackage.implausibleDateWarning: {{count}} row(s) have an implausible date and may need review.
accountantPackage.miscConcentrationWarning: "Misc" makes up {{pct}}% of this month's expenses — consider re-categorizing some of these into a more specific category before sending this to your accountant.
accountantPackage.capitalAssetsNote: Depreciable — Section 179 / bonus depreciation is your CPA's decision. Never counted in the expense totals above.
accountantPackage.noCapitalAssets: No capital asset purchases recorded yet.
accountantPackage.ownersEquityNote: Contributions are not taxable income; draws are not wages or a deductible expense.
accountantPackage.cashContributedNote: Cash you deposited into the business — capital in, not taxable income.
accountantPackage.expensesPaidPersonallyNote: Business expenses you paid from personal funds, not yet reimbursed — capital in.
accountantPackage.reimbursementsTakenBackNote: Personal reimbursements you've taken for expenses you paid — capital out, not a new business expense.
accountantPackage.ownerDrawsNote: Money drawn out of the business for personal use — capital out, not wages or a deductible expense.
accountantPackage.footerMealsNote: Meals are excluded here — they're covered by per diem, claimed separately.
accountantPackage.footerNonDeductibleNote: Advance repayments and escrow/deposit holdbacks are not deductible — they're loan principal or refundable deposits, not expenses.
accountantPackage.footerOwnerPaidNote: OWNER PAID rows are Owner Contributions — money you put into the business, not a business bank withdrawal.
accountantPackage.unmatchedOwnerPaidWarning: {{count}} owner-paid expense(s) have no matching contribution recorded.

scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.subtitle: Your business-health score at a glance.
scorecard.empty: Import a settlement to calculate your score.
scorecard.setManualTotalNote: Enter your odometer/ELD total miles. This supersedes the weekly figures calculated from your settlements for CPM/RPM until you switch back.
scorecard.duplicateWeeksIgnored: {{count}} duplicate settlement week(s) ignored — you may want to delete them.
scorecard.fixedVariableSummary: Variable {{variable}}/mi adds cash today. Total {{total}}/mi covers everything.
scorecard.cpmTooHighWarning: Your Cost/Mile ({{cpm}}) is unusually high — check the Why? breakdown for a one-time expense that may be skewing it.
scorecard.milesMissingWarning: No miles recorded yet — Cost/Mile and Revenue/Mile can't be calculated until you add miles to your settlements.
scorecard.whyTitle: Why is my Cost/Mile this number?
scorecard.whyFixedSpreadTitle: How your fixed truck cost was spread
scorecard.whyFixedSpreadNotSet: Not set — add your truck's cost basis (ownership mode, payment, warranty) on the Trucks screen to include it here.
scorecard.whyExcludedOneOffsNote: These are real expenses (kept in your P&L and tax estimate) but excluded from Cost/Mile — a one-time repair or purchase divided across one week's miles would spike the figure to something meaningless.
scorecard.whyMissingMilesTitle: Settlements with revenue but no miles
